text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 342, October 05, 1971 ]
ESTABLISHING THE POLLUTION RESEARCH CENTER OF THE PHILIPPINES
WHEREAS, environmental pollution and contamination are increasing at an alarming rate with
industrialization and mechanization; and
WHEREAS, the existing government machinery on anti-pollution is inadequate to cope with the problem;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby establish a Pollution Research Center at Fort Bonifacio.
The Center shall be manned by representatives of the Pollution Commission, the National Science
Development Board, the Department of Agriculture and Natural Resources, the Department of Public Works
and Communications, the Department of Health, the Department of National Defense, and such other officials
or private citizens as the President may designate.
The Center may call upon any department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the government for
such assistance as it may need in the form of personnel, facilities and other resources.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ROBERTO V. REYES
Acting Executive Secretary
